items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Did you have any book when you took lessons from Professor Umphrey? I had a big book, yeah.

ctx.x: When you took up the clarinet, you say you just played by ear? You didn't live?
Yeah, I did. No, I never did play ball music. I started with a... But with Mr. Umphrey. Umphrey, yeah. And after...
Can you tell us about his lessons? Where did he teach? At his home or did he come to your house?
